Daarnaast biedt het bedrijf een breed assortiment ten behoeve van vloerverwarmingsinstallaties. Er wordt jaarlijks een wereldwijde afzet gerealiseerd van meer dan 130 miljoen meter buis en meer dan 11 miljoen koppelingen met meer dan 300 medewerkers. Vacatureomschrijving Voor onze internationaal groeiende onderneming zijn wij op zoek naar een Personal Assistant voor onze CEO. Je bent hierbij de rechterhand van onze CEO en tevens ook Commercieel Directeur waarbij je hem ondersteunt in zijn dagelijks werk aan de hand van volgens takenpakket: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het volledige agendabeheer, het screenen en beantwoorden van oproepen, e-mails en het organiseren van vergaderingen voor het directieteam zowel intern als extern; Proactief prioriteiten stellen bij afspraken en vergaderingen om de beschikbaarheid van onze CEO te maximaliseren; Verzorgen van correspondentie in naam van onze CEO; Bijwonen en notuleren van vergaderingen met onze CEO en deze in CRM plaatsen; Je zorgt voor een vlekkeloze administratie in alle facetten; Je fungeert als back-up voor de organisatie van bedrijfs- en commerciële bezoeken en reisbeheer van onze werknemers met ondersteuning van een travel app; Het reisbeheer van onze CEO ligt volledig bij jou, waarbij je de CEO ook ondersteunt met gevraagde statistieken, info over de klant, etc.; Key-user van onze travel app die je in samenspraak met ons reisbureau voortdurend optimaliseert; Je takenpakket zal afgewisseld worden met receptie ondersteuning; Je denkt actief mee na over verbetering van processen waarmee je in aanraking komt, je denkt na in de vorm van oplossingen in plaats van in problemen; Je levert een administratieve ondersteuning aan de interne sales; Ondersteunen bij verscheidene HR processen en taken zoals het organiseren van familiedagen of bestellen van geschenken; Verder zal je verschillende ad hoc taken voor je rekening nemen. Functie-eisen Als Personal Assistant zit het in je bloed om alles steeds tot in de puntjes te organiseren en plannen met oog voor alle details en bijhorende administratie. Daarnaast ben je gedreven, communicatief en positief ingesteld. Mensen ondersteunen en een gevarieerd takenpakket zijn zaken die je plezier in jouw werk geven. Herken je jezelf in onderstaande? Aarzel dan niet en neem contact! Bij voorkeur bezit je een bachelor- of master diploma in een office gerelateerde richting zoals Office Management of Bedrijfsmanagement; Je hebt gedegen ervaring als directie assistant of management assistant; Met je vlotte IT kennis kan je je weg goed vinden in alle Microsoft office toepassingen; Op een integere en professionele manier omgaan met vertrouwelijke en bedrijfsgevoelige informatie is een evidentie voor jou die je hoog in het vaandel draagt; Je bent een administratieve duizendpoot en kan nauwkeurig en gestructureerd werken; Je hebt een kritische geest en oog voor detail: je durft initiatief nemen en verbeteringen of optimalisaties voor te stellen waar nodig zodat toekomstige problemen op een proactieve manier vermeden worden; Plannen en organiseren zijn jouw sterktes, je hebt een helikopterview waardoor je het overzicht kan bewaren; Je bent diplomatisch en empathisch, doch assertief; Met het nodige geduld sta je stevig in je schoenen en weet je op flexibele wijze door te zetten; Je bent communicatief sterk en je hebt een goede taalvaardigheid Nederlands/Engels/Frans/Duits; Naast enthousiast en gemotiveerd ben je leergierig en kom je graag goed voor de dag. review_candidates.title: Obstetrics/Gynecology
review_candidates.description: Role and Facility Information Gynaecologist, Endometriosis and Chronic Pelvic Pain Specialist, Department of Obstetrics & Gynaecology BC Women’s Hospital + Health Centre & The University of British Columbia (UBC) Vancouver, BC The Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, University of British Columbia, is seeking applications for a clinical faculty position in the Division of Gynaecologic Specialties, based at BC Women’s Hospital. The successful applicant will work as part of a dynamic clinical academic team providing advanced endometriosis surgical expertise and chronic pelvic pain management for the Province of British Columbia. This successful candidate will be joining the 6 gynecologists working at the BC Women’s Centre for Pelvic Pain and Endometriosis, a world renowned tertiary care hospital-based clinic which services the entire province. This full-time position will include: assessing patients in clinic, doing specialized ultrasounds, collaborating with the interdisciplinary team, performing surgeries at BCW Hospital and UBC/VGH hospitals and supervising residents and Clinical Fellows. This position will include providing call coverage for gynecologic emergencies at UBC/VGH by participating in the Doctor of the Day (DOD) call schedule. The successful candidate must have post-graduate training in minimally invasive surgery (MIS) as well as assessment and management of chronic pelvic pain and endometriosis. Desirable additional skills include advanced ultrasound skill in evaluation of deep endometriosis, robotic surgery and/or neuropelviology. Evidence of research activity is desired. Preference will be given to an early to mid career Gynaecologist who has a diversity of training experience and has demonstrated academic productivity and/or leadership experience. Reporting will be through to the Head of Obstetrics and Gynecology at BC Women’s Hospital, the Heads of Gynecology at Vancouver Acute Hospitals, the Head of the Division of Gynaecologic Specialties, and to the Head of the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology at UBC. It is expected that the successful candidate will apply for and hold a clinical faculty appointment in the Department of Obstetrics & Gynaecology at the University of British Columbia. As a clinical faculty member, the successful candidate will be expected to involve learners in clinical activity, and participate in program development and student evaluation as well as research and knowledge dissemination. Applicants must be eligible for registration with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of British Columbia, be a Fellow of the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada or equivalent and be eligible to hold a clinical faculty appointment at UBC. This is an excellent time for US-trained OBGYNs to consider relocating, thanks to significant recent regulatory changes in British Columbia, which now allows American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS) members to be eligible for full speciality class licensure. This position is funded by fee for service through the medical services plan of British Columbia. There is also a stipend from Vancouver Acute for DOD call and a stipend from UBC for clinical teaching of medical students and residents. The anticipated start date is September 1, 2026, but could be flexible depending on the successful candidate’s timeline. Applications, accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae and names of three references, should be directed to: Health Match BC Closing date: June 30, 2026 Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion PHSA, BCW & UBC are committed to employment equity, encouraging all qualified individuals to apply. We recognize that our ability to provide the best care for our diverse patient populations relies on a rich diversity of skills, knowledge, background and experience, and value a safe, inclusive and welcoming environment. The successful candidate will also demonstrate a commitment to beginning and continuing their personal learning journey related to Indigenous-specific racism and dismantling systems of oppression, as well as addressing racism more broadly. Shows willingness to articulate and share their learning experiences to contribute to a culture of motivation and inspiration among peers. As a strong asset for consideration, we are looking for our successful candidate to have: Foundational knowledge of the social, economic, and political realities of settler-colonialism and its impacts on Indigenous peoples and equity-deserving groups within social and health contexts. Understands the impact of social determinants of health-on-health outcomes. Shows a commitment to learning about and upholding legislative obligations and provincial commitments outlined in foundational documents such as the Truth & Reconciliation Commission’s Calls to Action (2015), In Plain Sight (2020), BC's Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples Act (2019), United Nations Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples (UNDRIP), Reclaiming Power and Place: Missing and Murdered Indigenous Women & Girls Calls for Justice (2019), the Declaration Act Action Plan, Remembering Keegan: A First Nations Case Study, the BC Human Rights Code, Anti-Racism Data Act, and the Distinctions Based Approach. What we do BC Women's Hospital & Health Centre (BCW) is dedicated to improving the health of women, newborns and families through a comprehensive range of services, research and education. PHSA plans, manages and evaluates specialized health services with the BC health authorities to provide equitable and cost-effective health care for people throughout the province. Our values reflect our commitment to excellence and include: Respect people – Be compassionate – Dare to innovate – Create equity – Be courageous. PHSA, BCW & UBC are committed to anti-racism and equity in our hiring and employment practices. With learning and compassion, we are addressing existing inequities and barriers throughout our systems. PHSA is seeking to create a diverse workforce and to establish an inclusive and culturally safe environment. We invite applications and enquiries from all people, particularly those belonging to the historically, systemically, and/or persistently excluded groups identified under the B.C. Human Rights Code. One of PHSA’s North Star priorities is to eradicate Indigenous-specific racism, which includes ongoing commitments to Indigenous recruitment and employee experience as well as dismantling barriers to health care employment at every level. review_candidates.title: Merchandiser
review_candidates.description: About The Team You'll join our Commercial team under Operations, reporting to the Manager Operasional, and working closely with Sales, PPIC, Product, Marketing, Finance, and Warehouse. This role sits right at the intersection of all of them, which is exactly where it needs to be. About The Role As Merchandiser, you're the commercial owner of our assortment and inventory. Your job is making sure the right product is available in the right quantity, in the right channel, at the right time, with the right price, so every rupiah sitting in inventory has a clear commercial reason to be there. You're not just watching what sells. You're deciding what we should carry, how much, where, and for how long, and you're the one who can say "this product doesn't need a discount" when the data backs it up. What You'll Do Merchandise Planning: Build demand forecasts and assortment plans (width, depth, core vs. seasonal) based on real sales data and business priorities. Inventory Management: Monitor stock health, catching overstock, understock, slow-moving, and deadstock before they become bigger problems. Replenishment & Allocation: Decide what needs restocking, how much, and where it should go, across channels and stores. Product Lifecycle: Track products from launch through decline, and know when to scale, maintain, or exit. Markdown Strategy: Identify genuine markdown candidates using evidence, not just because sales dipped for a week. Trading Analysis: Run daily, weekly, and monthly reviews, turning numbers into clear, evidence-based recommendations. What We're Looking For 2–4 years of experience in merchandising, e-commerce, retail, or FMCG (Merchandiser level); adjusted for Junior or Senior depending on experience. Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills (pivot, XLOOKUP, SUMIFS) and comfort with commercial math: margin, ROI, inventory turnover. Someone who's genuinely comfortable with numbers but also understands product and customer, not purely data-driven, not purely instinct-driven. Detail-oriented: you know a size curve mistake can turn into a real inventory problem. Not afraid to challenge a production plan or a discount decision when the evidence doesn't support it. Preferred background in Business, Management, Fashion Business, Industrial Engineering, Statistics, or Supply Chain, though strong analytical and commercial judgment matters more than the degree itself.
